source.note: Vector drawings, raster image objects and text spans extracted from the Inkscape-polished reference PDF with PyMuPDF; page coordinates in points, y down from the top-left corner. Rasters are the original image streams, replayed at their measured placements. Image placements additionally carry paths_before: the number of vector paint operators that precede the placement in the reference content stream; the replay renders each raster at that z rank. Drawing opacities and the span/image alphas above were cross-checked against a full content-stream walk (459/459 paints match get_drawings in order; per-paint ExtGState ca/CA agrees with the stored fill_opacity/stroke_opacity). Inset images 26/29/32/35 carry PDF SMask alpha channels (FlateDecode grayscale, xrefs 284-287) stored verbatim as the referenced PNG files; only the track core is opaque, the basemap below shows through.
